profile.name: Shota Khakhishvili
profile.title: UE5 Gameplay Programmer
profile.intro: I build gameplay-first experiences in Unreal Engine 5, from fast arcade loops to simulation prototypes. My focus is responsive controls, clear game feel, and clean gameplay systems.

skillsIntro: Core competencies in Unreal Engine gameplay programming, rapid prototyping, and practical systems used to ship playable experiences.
projectsIntro: Selected systems, engine, simulation, and gameplay projects focused on performance, modular architecture, and practical implementation.

projects.title: Procedural Surface Generation
projects.description: Chunk-based terrain system with LOD, spatial hashing, and multithreaded generation. Reduces frame hitches by 8.5x through async chunk loading and memory pooling.

projects.title: KIU Infinite Runner (Custom Engine)
projects.description: An infinite runner prototype built in 48 hours with a custom C++/OpenGL framework, combining real-time rendering, instancing, and modular gameplay systems.

projects.title: UE5 Data Table Query Plugin
projects.description: Plugin architecture enabling relational data management with SQL-like queries in Blueprints. Demonstrates plugin development, serialization, and data abstraction patterns.

projects.title: ISS Cupola Simulator (NASA Space Apps)
projects.description: 3D spatial simulation with zero-gravity interaction systems, deployed via Pixel Streaming. Features input abstraction layer and real-time environment feedback.

projects.title: PropGenie (3D Renovation Simulator)
projects.description: Real-time UI-driven asset spawning and customization system in UE5. Demonstrates data binding, material swapping, and dynamic property exposure.

projects.title: ML Self-Taught Cars
projects.description: Machine learning agent training system in UE5. Demonstrates neural network integration with gameplay mechanics and reward loop design.

projects.title: Goat Ate Vineyard (Global Game Jam)
projects.description: Transformation state machine with counter-progression hierarchy. Systems-driven gameplay where each form enables/disables abilities in structured ruleset.

projects.title: Trapshooter
projects.description: Input-responsive arcade shooter demonstrating polished feel through precise control mapping, lag compensation, and rapid feedback loops.

projects.title: Bending Simulator
projects.description: Ability system with chained state transitions and balanced resource flow. Demonstrates combat loop design through elemental control mechanics.

projects.title: Survival Game
projects.description: Progression system with crafting loops and resource management. Demonstrates data-driven gameplay and systemic player interaction.

projects.title: Subway Surfers Remake
projects.description: Procedural lane navigation with tuned traversal feel. Implements constant-forward movement and reactive lane-switching feedback.

projects.title: Bend It All
projects.description: Environmental manipulation sandbox with physics-based interactions. Demonstrates constraint-based gameplay and dynamic object linking systems.

contactIntro: Open to UE5 gameplay programming roles, prototype-heavy collaboration, and teams that value strong player experience.
contactDescription: Reach out by email or connect through platforms below. I am always interested in discussing gameplay systems, combat feel, and how to ship polished, fun interactive experiences.
